no_adcom_quote.quote: ERIVEDGE was not referred for review to the Oncologics Drugs Advisory Committee because outside expertise was not necessary.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for ERIVEDGE (NDA203388). The Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, and Office Director Memo all state the drug was not referred to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee because there were no controversial issues requiring outside expertise, with the magnitude and duration of the objective response rate reflecting unequivocal clinical benefit in a population with no other effective therapies. Because no committee met, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
